adapted: 2026-09-29 — adapté à Angular 19 (19.2.21, zone.js, sans SSR) pour warhammer40k ; le v20+ est retiré ou marqué non applicable
abstract: Guide to modern Angular development adapted to Angular 19 for the warhammer40k frontend. Covers Signals, Standalone Components, signal inputs and queries, routing, dependency injection, forms, @defer and testing. Zoneless, SSR/hydration and Signal Forms (v20+) are marked as not applicable.
